tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining DUtch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colnnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.

I had a great time eating food at Rodizios, a Brazilian steak house. I enjoyed this experience with my family. We ate until we were completely full. I spent more money than I expected. I felt sick the next day. But eating Brazilian cheese bread and steak was a memory I'll never forget.
